transitions.title: Android media permission dialog
transitions.trigger: Local media access is first required after a one-purpose explanation.
transitions.handoff: App launches the Android-owned media permission request; the OS result is authoritative.
transitions.service: Existing valid Playback Service state is preserved; no false library readiness is created.
transitions.returnPath: Granted resumes scan/readiness. Denied returns to app recovery with Retry and Not now.
transitions.retry: A requestable denial may be retried explicitly; permanent denial uses the separate Settings handoff.
transitions.privacy: No media name, URI, path or content enters telemetry.
transitions.driving: Never shown as a Driving Mode page.
transitions.talkback: Purpose → Continue/Not now → Android dialog → returned result.

transitions.title: Android microphone permission dialog
transitions.trigger: The user explicitly taps Mic or chooses Voice practice; never on app or Driving Mode entry.
transitions.handoff: App launches the Android-owned microphone dialog after purpose text.
transitions.service: Playback remains service-owned and usable; capture starts only after a fresh Granted result.
transitions.returnPath: Granted continues capability check. Denied returns to manual controls; permanent denial offers Settings only outside Driving Mode.
transitions.retry: Requestable denial may retry. No automatic dialog loop and no capture during Retry choice.
transitions.privacy: Raw audio/transcript is absent before grant and prohibited from evidence/telemetry.
transitions.driving: In Driving Mode, denial returns immediately to fixed manual controls and Exit.
transitions.talkback: Mic purpose → Continue/Not now → Android dialog → returned result → manual controls.

transitions.title: Notification permission and visibility boundary
transitions.trigger: Only after acknowledged playback/background-control value exists.
transitions.handoff: Android permission/visibility result controls surface availability, not playback truth.
transitions.service: Playback and MediaSession continue when notification access is denied where platform policy permits.
transitions.returnPath: Granted enables the surface; denied returns to app controls with truthful visibility status.
transitions.retry: Settings recovery is explicit and outside Driving Mode; no repeated prompt.
transitions.privacy: Notification content follows approved media-surface privacy; denial is coarse state only.
transitions.driving: No permission or Settings setup surface is opened in active Driving Mode.
transitions.talkback: Notification purpose → system handoff → result → Continue with manual playback.

transitions.title: Android Settings handoff and recheck
transitions.trigger: The user explicitly chooses Open Settings for permanent permission/provider recovery.
transitions.handoff: The app leaves through an explicit Android Settings intent and assumes no success.
transitions.service: Active playback is preserved; Settings never becomes playback authority.
transitions.returnPath: On return, the app rechecks Granted, requestable denial, or still permanent/unavailable as distinct outcomes.
transitions.retry: No automatic loop back into Settings; Not now and Back return to manual control.
transitions.privacy: No settings value or device identity is emitted as telemetry.
transitions.driving: Open Settings is never offered or launched from active Driving Mode.
transitions.talkback: Leaving-app notice → Open Settings/Not now → system surface → Checking → result/manual controls.

transitions.title: Cloud Voice consent outside Driving Mode
transitions.trigger: An approved network-assisted Voice adapter is selected and complete disclosure exists.
transitions.handoff: App shows purpose, processing destination and retention disclosure outside Driving Mode; this is consent, not Android permission.
transitions.service: Decline or missing disclosure keeps Voice Manual Only and never affects local playback.
transitions.returnPath: Accept/Decline/Revoke persists a versioned local decision and returns to Settings/manual playback.
transitions.retry: No coercive countdown, preselection or repeated prompt; future change is user-initiated in Settings.
transitions.privacy: Raw audio/transcript destination and retention must be truthful; no dark pattern.
transitions.driving: Consent UI is prohibited in active Driving Mode; immediately return to manual controls.
transitions.talkback: Cloud processing heading → purpose/destination/retention → Accept → Decline → Back.

transitions.title: Media Notification controls
transitions.trigger: A valid active MediaSession exposes the platform notification surface.
transitions.handoff: Play/Pause/Next/Previous commands travel through Android MediaSession; the surface waits for acknowledgement.
transitions.service: Service owns queue/player/state and refreshes all app/system surfaces from one snapshot.
transitions.returnPath: Acknowledged command updates notification and app. Unavailable surface returns control to the app without fabricating stop.
transitions.retry: A pending command is serialized; rejection/timeout refreshes truth before any safe retry.
transitions.privacy: No notification command or media identity is copied into project evidence.
transitions.driving: System controls do not auto-open Driving Mode.
transitions.talkback: Track/state → Previous → Play/Pause → Next → open app; pending/failure announced by the system.

transitions.title: Lock-screen media controls
transitions.trigger: Device locks or screen turns off while a valid MediaSession exists.
transitions.handoff: Android renders lock-screen controls; the app does not invent or own this screen.
transitions.service: Playback continues from service truth; commands remain pending until acknowledgement.
transitions.returnPath: Unlock/app return reconnects to the complete current snapshot; surface absence is not playback failure.
transitions.retry: Rejected/system-unavailable command refreshes state and restores reachable app controls.
transitions.privacy: Platform surface follows approved metadata policy; no lock state or media identity telemetry.
transitions.driving: Lock-screen surface is never represented as an in-app Driving destination.
transitions.talkback: Android owns focus order and labels; app documents only handoff, command and return.

transitions.title: External media keys and controller handoff
transitions.trigger: A supported Bluetooth/headset/vehicle media key issues a MediaSession command.
transitions.handoff: Android routes the command; no separate app player or queue is created.
transitions.service: The shared service validates, serializes and acknowledges the command.
transitions.returnPath: All visible surfaces refresh from the authoritative snapshot; unsupported/unavailable returns to app manual controls.
transitions.retry: No optimistic duplicate command; safe retry only after refresh.
transitions.privacy: External device name/address and media payload are prohibited from telemetry.
transitions.driving: A media-key command never auto-enters Driving Mode.
transitions.talkback: System controller labels are platform-owned; app feedback reflects acknowledged state only.

transitions.title: UI recreation and Playback Service reconnect
transitions.trigger: UI recreation, return from background, task/OEM event or controller loss.
transitions.handoff: UI shows bounded Connecting and requests one complete service snapshot; it creates no replacement player.
transitions.service: Service remains authority for item, queue, state, position and supported actions.
transitions.returnPath: Complete snapshot restores truthful Playing/Paused/Completed. Missing lifecycle may use validated P1 Paused Restore only.
transitions.retry: Repeated reconnect failure exposes Retry/Back; invalid restore routes to Library and never auto-plays.
transitions.privacy: No personal media snapshot enters telemetry; only coarse connection failure may be approved.
transitions.driving: Driving reconnect keeps Exit enabled and never fabricates metadata or Playing.
transitions.talkback: Connecting status → Retry/Back → refreshed player state and actions.

transitions.title: Phone Call and Audio Focus interruption
transitions.trigger: Transient/permanent Audio Focus loss, call, duck request or focus callback error.
transitions.handoff: Android supplies focus/call category only; Voice is canceled and no call identity is read.
transitions.service: Service pauses or ducks. Resume occurs only when all four guards pass and service acknowledges it.
transitions.returnPath: Valid transient gain may return to actual Playing; any failed guard or permanent loss remains Safe Paused with manual Resume.
transitions.retry: No hidden auto-retry. Manual Resume rechecks route/focus before command.
transitions.privacy: No phone number, contact, call identity or personal media identity is stored.
transitions.driving: Driving surface shows concise Interrupted/Safe Paused and fixed manual controls/Exit.
transitions.talkback: Interrupted/Paused status → manual Resume if safe → Exit; no unexpected speech or audio.

transitions.title: Wired/headset disconnect and reconnect
transitions.handoff: Android route change invalidates the previous route generation immediately.
transitions.service: Service pauses at disconnect, cancels Voice and prevents speaker leakage.
transitions.returnPath: Reconnect rechecks route but never auto-resumes; explicit Play may resume after acknowledgement.
transitions.retry: Manual Play is the only resume attempt; a new loss returns immediately to Safe Paused.
transitions.privacy: No route/device identity or address is logged.
transitions.driving: Driving Mode remains one layer with Safe Paused, manual Play and Exit.
transitions.talkback: Route disconnected → Safe Paused → route available → explicit Play/Exit.

transitions.title: Bluetooth route loss and reconnect
transitions.trigger: Selected/current Bluetooth output route disconnects or reconnects.
transitions.handoff: Android route truth controls output; connection alone never opens Driving Mode.
transitions.service: Service immediately pauses on loss, invalidates the route and prevents speaker fallback leakage.
transitions.returnPath: Reconnect produces Safe Paused. Explicit manual Play revalidates route and waits for service acknowledgement.
transitions.retry: No automatic Resume. Failed manual Play stays Safe Paused with Exit/manual controls.
transitions.privacy: Bluetooth device name, address and stable identity are excluded from telemetry.
transitions.driving: No suggestion/setup during active recovery; fixed Play and Exit remain reachable.
transitions.talkback: Bluetooth disconnected → Safe Paused → reconnected → explicit Play/Exit.

transitions.title: Driving Voice one-Retry manual fallback
transitions.trigger: The first explicit Voice attempt settles as timeout/no-match/provider/language/network/audio failure.
transitions.handoff: Voice releases capture/duck and shows Retry once plus Manual/Exit; no auto-capture.
transitions.service: Underlying Playback Service state remains unchanged unless a command was acknowledged.
transitions.returnPath: Retry starts attempt two. Any second failure immediately dismisses to fixed manual controls; a new session needs a new mic tap.
transitions.retry: Exactly one explicit Retry; no third attempt, countdown coercion or Settings detour.
transitions.privacy: Only coarse allowlisted failure may be recorded; no audio/transcript/candidate/media identity.
transitions.driving: Manual Previous/Play-Pause/Next/Seek Back and Exit are immediately reachable after failure.
transitions.talkback: Failure reason → Retry once → Manual controls → Exit; focus returns to the initiating control.
